Title: 485572-2026: France – Construction work – Creation of an urban higher education campus on the Maret site in Dijon
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New university/campus construction corresponds to a priority area of interest for sbp (higher education/campus development). However, technical/structural details are missing and the project is located outside the DACH region, therefore only medium-high priority.
titel: Construction of an urban higher education campus on the Maret site in Dijon
kurzbeschreibung: On the Maret site in Dijon, a new urban campus for the higher education sector is being built. This notice concerns individual construction lots (roofing, interior fit-out, acoustic curtains, metalwork, screeds) as part of the construction works.
wettbewerb_art: Award of construction works (open procedure, no design competition)
gewinner: PATEU ET ROBERT (Lot 7 – roofing/zinc work); LEBLOND (Lot 11 – interior fit-out/interior joinery); PYT AUDIO (Lot 12 – acoustic curtains); ALKIMIA (Lot 13 – metalwork/steel external windows); CDI (Lot 15 – screed works)
gewinner_rolle: Construction companies or executing firms for individual trades
gewinner_kontakt:
Total value of the contracts awarded in this notice: 2,139,134.91 EUR
Lot 7 – PATEU ET ROBERT: 111,559.90 EUR
Lot 11 – LEBLOND: 791,458.25 EUR
Lot 12 – PYT AUDIO: 122,560.75 EUR
Lot 13 – ALKIMIA: 853,556.00 EUR
Lot 15 – CDI: 260,000.01 EUR
projektbeteiligte:
Rectorat de la région académique BFC – public contracting authority/client
PATEU ET ROBERT – contractor Lot 7 (roofing in tiles, zinc work)
LEBLOND – contractor Lot 11 (interior fit-out, interior joinery)
PYT AUDIO – contractor Lot 12 (acoustic curtains)
ALKIMIA – contractor Lot 13 (metalwork, steel external windows)
CDI – contractor Lot 15 (screed works)
Tribunal Administratif de Dijon – review body
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- University campus is generally within the building segment of interest to sbp
- This notice only concerns execution trades, not structural or architectural design
- Project is located in France, with no indication of special or long-span structures
- Structural design and overall planning have obviously already been awarded, no clear starting point for cooperation with the winners of the lots
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Notice relates to construction execution, not to checking engineer services
- Project status: award of fit-out and metalwork trades, structural design already completed
- Outside Germany, no indications of a separate tender for structural checking
- Not a bridge or special structure, but a conventional higher education building
baukosten_erklaerung: Read from the notice: sum of the contract values stated in the notice (2,139,134.91 EUR), only part of the total construction costs of the campus; used as a rough lower bound for cost groups 300/400 and rounded to 2,100,000
naechste_schritte: No further steps required; neither contacting the executing firms nor considering checking engineer services is recommended.
notes: The TED notice covers only a section (Lots 7, 11, 12, 13, 15) of the overall project "Campus urbain d'enseignement supérieur sur le site Maret". Planning services (architecture/structures) were not addressed in this notice and were presumably already awarded in earlier procedures.
